source_metadata.quarantine_reason: DOI 10.1021/jf3032779 does not resolve (CrossRef HTTP 404) and no source could be identified. The real Parker 2012 acrylamide paper (10.1021/jf302415n) is a kinetic model of COMMERCIAL French fries during finish frying, not a 10 mM asparagine/glucose aqueous model system, so the DOI cannot simply be repointed. The file also carries the TIGHTEST validation contract in the whole collection (max_ratio 1.05, mean_abs_log10_error 0.02) -- a tolerance that narrow is a fitting tell, not an earned measurement uncertainty. Same pattern as the three files quarantined earlier on this date.
